meta.title: Quadro Coffee | Köşklüçiftlik, Nicosia
meta.description: Coffee shop in Köşklüçiftlik, Nicosia. Hot and cold coffees, non-coffee drinks, wine, beer and whisky, a terrace, live music and match nights. Memduh Asaf Sokak 15/C.

hero.title:
Your corner
in Köşklüçiftlik.
hero.text: From your morning coffee to an evening glass of wine. Coffees, beer and whisky on our terrace in Köşklüçiftlik, one of Nicosia's oldest and most beautiful neighbourhoods.
hero.imageAlt: A café terrace with plants and string lights in late-afternoon light

items.quote: A truly elegant and stylish coffeeshop located on a beautiful street, with a lovely terrace and coffees prepared with love!
items.name: Johannes M.

items.quote: Really enjoyed a flat white there. I tried the coffee in few other places but they were either too liquid or too hot or some other issues. They really know what is the difference between latte and flat white and their approach was very friendly.
items.name: Vahid M.

items.quote: First time I've ever written a review for anything, but seriously excellent customer service, cosy and aesthetic atmosphere, the barista was so welcoming and friendly and the coffee was delicious. Will definitely come again. …
items.name: Melin
